content.text: {"subject":"Fractions","aditiApplicable":true,"aditiHook":"Have you ever shared a pizza or a chocolate bar with a friend? When you split it into equal pieces, you're using fractions!","notes":["A fraction is a part of a whole thing — it tells you how many equal pieces you have out of the total.","A half means you cut something into 2 equal pieces. Each piece is called 1/2 (one-half). Two halves make 1 whole.","A quarter means you cut something into 4 equal pieces. Each piece is called 1/4 (one-quarter). Four quarters make 1 whole.","The top number (numerator) tells you how many pieces you're using. The bottom number (denominator) tells you how many equal pieces the whole was cut into.","Examples: 1/2 of 8 apples = 4 apples. 1/4 of 8 apples = 2 apples.","2/4 is the same as 1/2 because two quarters equal one half.","You can draw circles or rectangles, divide them into equal parts, and shade the parts to show fractions like 1/2 or 1/4."]}
